The test image shows an opened soybean pod with 3 seeds: two normal yellow/cream seeds and one with a prominent purple/violet blotch. There's also some white material visible inside the pod. Key features: seed with purple staining, pod interior discoloration.

Top candidates: **Purple_Seed_Stain** (pink to purple seed blotches) and **Cercospora** (pink to purple seed coat discoloration). Let me view reference images.

The bottom-right panel of the Purple_Seed_Stain reference collage is an almost identical match to the test image: opened soybean pod held in hand, with one seed showing a purple blotch. The Cercospora reference shows leaf symptoms (reddish-purple leaf discoloration), not seed symptoms.

Let me view a few more reference images to be thorough.
Neither Downy mildew nor Phomopsis match. Let me view 2 more references to meet the 6-image minimum.

White Mold shows fluffy stem mold; Anthracnose shows dark pod lesions. Neither matches.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: opened soybean pod, one seed with prominent purple/violet blotch
- Purple_Seed_Stain reference: bottom-right panel shows nearly identical image (hand holding opened pod, seed with purple staining)
- Cercospora reference: shows leaf symptoms only (reddish-purple leaf discoloration)
- Symptom description match: "pink to purple spots ranging from specks to large blotches... discoloration extending from the seed hilum" — exact match
